title: How Can Businesses Turn Phone Call Transcripts into Actionable Sales Insights?
summary: Phone call transcripts can become actionable sales insights once businesses use AI-powered conversation intelligence to identify customer intent, uncover common objections, detect buying signals, and identify call outcomes across large volumes of customer conversations. Rather than manually reviewing individual calls, organizations can analyze thousands of interactions at scale to understand what triggers conversions, where sales opportunities are lost, and how customer conversations influence sales outcomes.
